findings.reason: Runtime config shows the new values in effect from 05:23:34, inside the window.

findings.claim: The single-connection pool timed out on acquisition (152 timeouts) while borrowers queued, in the same period as the blocking.
findings.reason: Max 1, 152 timeouts, pending above zero 05:23:38-05:24:28, 250 ms timeout.

findings.claim: A session idle in transaction blocked another ledger_app session for up to 1.9 s (05:23:36-05:24:30), holding the sole connection and starving others.
findings.reason: The blocking interval matches the pool-pending interval.

findings.claim: Transfers failed (22 HTTP 500, 97 HTTP 503; 29.5% server errors) with p99 2.2 s. These are likely the pool timeouts.
